% These macros REPLACE the \RealBeta* family in the abstract and the
% regime-map table, so the corpus-anchored figure and the

% are the right thing to cite when the two policies are compared.
%
% GATES. Reproduction of \MzeroGain through this code path:

% CONVENTION: Gain macros expand WITH a trailing percent sign. A macro whose
% value is negative carries an explicit LaTeX minus sign. Percentage-POINT
% differences carry an explicit sign and no percent sign.
% Macro names contain no digits (LaTeX forbids them); numerals are spelt out.
% ===========================================================================
